title: Common-stage equality of canonical signed line representatives
statement: For a finite-field datum, a prime different from its characteristic, an algebraic closure of the prime-adic coefficient field, finite intermediate fields F ≤ L, and a common overfield M of F and L, use the fixed signed Tate presentations and stage comparisons [def-pur-point-tate-comparison-data] with canonicalSheaf [def-pur-point-tate-canonical-comparisons]. The source morphism twistPairComparison from F to L is equal to mkHom at M of stageLineComparison F M followed by the inverse stageLineComparison L M. This is equality in the constructible common-stage source category [def-weil-algebraically-closed-coefficients], before applying a point fibre.

proof.text: the normalized ordinary signed scalar maps compose along coefficient towers: at degree zero use the coefficient map, at degree one keep the root tensor, and for positive powers tensor the formula. For negative powers evaluate on the positive generator; nondegeneracy gives the same composition identity. The ordinary/completed model isomorphism preserves all pure tensors, so transports this identity to canonicalSheaf. The completion comparison is natural and the point-free completed scalar associator is its conjugate of the ordinary tensor associator. Thus the completedLineComparison isomorphisms satisfy the same tower identity. Restrict to constructible objects and rationalize; the specified object equalities in rationalLineComparison and stageLineComparison transport this tower identity to the recorded stage system. Transport the representative defining twistPairComparison from L to a common stage M. The resulting composite is the F-to-M line map followed by the inverse L-to-M map: the two copies of the L-to-M image of the identity-stage comparison cancel, and the tower equation combines the remaining F-to-L and L-to-M maps. The common-stage equivalence relation identifies these representatives, proving the stated source morphism equality. This also covers M=L and the identity extension.

theorem canonicalCommonStage (hl : l ≠ D.p)
    (Ω : Type u) [Field Ω] [Algebra (Padic l) Ω] [IsAlgClosure (Padic l) Ω]
    (F L M : Padic.FiniteCoefficientFields l Ω) (hFL : F ≤ L)
    (hFM : F ≤ M) (hLM : L ≤ M) (m : ℤ) :
    twistPairComparison D l hl Ω F L hFL m (canonicalSheaf D l hl) =
      StageSystem.PairCategory.mkHom M hFM hLM
        ((stageLineComparison D l hl Ω F M hFM m (canonicalSheaf D l hl)).hom ≫
          (stageLineComparison D l hl Ω L M hLM m (canonicalSheaf D l hl)).inv)
